questions.prompt: What is the capital city of United Arab Emirates?

hints.nudge: A capital city is where a country’s government meets. The other three are capital cities too, of other countries.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the United Arab Emirates article.

questions.proof: The capital is Abu Dhabi, and the largest city is Dubai.

questions.prompt: Which of these countries shares a border with United Arab Emirates?

hints.nudge: Two countries are neighbours when you can walk from one into the other. Picture United Arab Emirates on the globe and look at what it touches.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the United Arab Emirates article.

questions.proof: It borders Oman, Qatar, and Saudi Arabia.

questions.prompt: Which language is an official language of United Arab Emirates?

hints.nudge: An official language is the one used in schools, courts and government. The other three are spoken in other countries.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the “History” part of the United Arab Emirates article.

questions.proof: After the start of Islam a new chapter began in the area, during the Umayyad period, the area of the Arabic Gulf was stable and it became important for navigation and shipping.

questions.prompt: Fill the gap: “9,304,277 people live in the UAE (December _____).”

hints.nudge: It is a year in the twenty-first century.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the United Arab Emirates article.

questions.prompt: Fill the gap: “The first export of oil took place in the year _____, the former president Zayed bin Sultan Al Nahyan wanted to use these resources in building infrastructure for starting economic and civilization development.”

hints.nudge: It is a year in the twentieth century.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the “Development of the UAE” part of the United Arab Emirates article.

questions.proof: The first export of oil took place in the year 1962, the former president Zayed bin Sultan Al Nahyan wanted to use these resources in building infrastructure for starting economic and civilization development.
